author: Yffe
content: Failing test at thermite-tv/tests/divergence_index_combinator.rs::ref_encode_index_arg_not_slice_viewed demonstrates the divergence. ref_encode::encode_combinator_call routes every combinator arg through encode_slice_arg, which appends @ to any bare non-seq-bound Path. For forall_below(xs, n, |x| x<=7) — registry arg_kinds [Slice, Index, Pred], n: int — the int index arg is encoded as n@, a Verus type error (no view on int). Confirmed against real verus 0.2026.05.24: the faithful obligation does not even compile. Slice+pred combinators (forall_in/exists_in/count_where) generalize correctly; only the Index-arg combinators (forall_below/forall_from) are mis-encoded — the encoder is overfit to F2's shape. Authority: contract-tv.md REQ-1 (covers all 8 frozen combinators) + thermite-design.md §4.2 (frozen registry). Test is #[ignore]d pending fix (R-DEFER-3); fails when run with --ignored.
